item.title: Unheard. Unserved: Black women face added health care barriers as race, gender intersect
item.description: In the final installment of the Global News' series Unheard. Unserved, we look how gender and race can intersect to create even deeper gaps in treatment and outcomes for women.

item.title: Reported illnesses have tripled in some school districts. Experts say mental health is a factor
item.description: A CBC investigation finds that school time lost due to reported illness is up in all districts that provided data — more than tripling in some places compared to five years ago. While the data doesn’t say why, experts say deteriorating mental health is causing some kids to stay home.
